title: Ironbeard's Tomb
wikitext:
[[Image:Ironbeard's Tomb.jpg|thumb|Ironbeard's Tomb]]
[[Ironbeard's Tomb]] is located just west of the road to [[Dun Modr]] in north-central [[Wetlands]]. The Ironbeard clan's crypt has been defiled by [[ooze]]s in black, crimson, and monstrous varieties, and none who wish to bury their dead come here any longer. Adventurers often journey to the tomb in hopes of locating [[Sida]]'s lost bag, which can rarely be found on any given ooze in the area.
